items.label: SMART POCKET DESIGN
items.value: The front features a large open pocket and a zippered pocket for quick access—great for teachers (pens, sticky notes, clicker), nurses (scissors, tape, penlight), or moms (tissues, wipes, diapers, snacks). On the back, a hidden zippered pocket keeps valuables like your phone, wallet, or keys close to your body for extra safety.

items.label: EXPANDABLE WATER BOTTLE HOLDER
items.value: Zipper expansion fits up to a 40oz tumbler (Stanley-compatible), with an elastic strap to hold it tight. Perfect for your morning coffee, large water bottle, or iced tea on the go. No more spills or tipping over—whether you're rushing to work, driving long hours, or working a busy shift. Keeps you hydrated all day long.

items.label: LARGE CAPACITY & SEPARATE LAPTOP COMPARTMENT
items.value: Separate padded slots fit both a 15.6-inch laptop and a tablet at the same time. The hard leather exterior adds extra protection from bumps. The main compartment easily holds thick books, files, and even a bulky laptop charger without bulging or making it hard to zip closed. No more struggling to close your bag.

items.label: STRUCTURED HARD LEATHER
items.value: Keeps its shape even when empty—no sagging or flopping over. Stays looking great even when fully packed. The smooth surface is easy to clean; just wipe with a damp cloth. Built to last with a durable finish that resists scratches and everyday wear. Perfect for setting on classroom floors, nurse stations, or airport belts without worry.

items.label: EASY TO USE FOR WORK, TRAVEL & MORE
items.value: Looks professional at the office, and also works perfectly as a diaper bag, weekend bag, or daily carry for campus and library use. Padded handles feel comfortable to carry all day.The luggage strap slides over your suitcase for easy travel, whether you're catching a flight or taking a train.

items.label: A GREAT GIFT FOR BUSY WOMEN
items.value: Stylish and practical, it’s a perfect choice for teachers, nurses, college women, working women, and moms. One bag that works as a laptop bag, work tote, diaper bag, gym bag, shopping tote, and overnight bag—ready for whatever life brings. Give her something she’ll actually use and love every day!

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand Wash Gently, Machine Wash Separately (Polyester Parts)
